newsitem.title: USA: Intel CEO nets $94.6 mln via options - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Intel CEO nets $94.6 mln via options - WSJ.

text.p: Intel Corp Chief Executive Officer Andy Grove accrued about $94.6 million in 1996 by exercising stock options, the Wall Street Journal said in Wednesday's electronic edition.
Grove exercised options to buy about one million shares last year, paying between $6.94 to $61.38 per share, the paper said, citing a company filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
Intel shares closed on Tuesday at $146.609, up $1.484.

An Intel spokesman was quoted as saying in the newspaper Grove sold 440,000 of the shares he received to pay taxes on the projected profits. He donated another 200,000 shares to charity and added 80,000 to his personal portfolio, the paper said. Grove held 1.54 million Intel shares at the end of February, worth about $226 million, it said.
